## Project Overview
This is a Vite React project for uploading fantasy football keepers, fetching ESPN player data via an API, and downloading a CSV with Name, ID, Team, Position, Keeper Round, and ESPN ADP Round columns.

## Key Features
- Player search with autocomplete
- Keeper round selection
- ADP comparison
- CSV export for ESPN fantasy football

## Code Style
- Use modern React hooks (useState, useEffect)
- Material-UI components for consistent styling
- Clean, readable code with proper error handling
- Responsive design principles
